differences.what: the 1863 frame house behind the brick front (x about 150-250 px): a two-storey range, its walls clapboarded and painted a mid tone a shade darker than Little's pale front, under a slated roof with tall brick chimneys, where the record had stood a flat-decked brick wing
differences.how: T-3566: the 1911 sheet's rear range rebuilt as a frame wing lapped in clapboards (rear_wings[].clapboard, 0.115 m to the weather) under a 45 degree slated gable whose ridge runs back from the main block, with two brick stacks to 15.0 m astride the ridge; its eave lands within about 5 px of the print's

differences.what: the frame house's front half as the print shows it, west of x about 155 px: its columned porch, its two tallest chimneys and its south face as far as Little's front
differences.how: the print is of 1893-1901, before the brick front was taken off the street line and set back to the building line (Tribune, 28 Nov. 1901: the sale required it rebuilt or moved back; the 1911 sheet draws it 9.7 m back). Set back, the front block stands on that part of the frame house, so in 1904 the porch and those stacks were gone or behind it; the record builds what the 1911 sheet keeps behind the block

differences.what: the print's frame house runs about 40 px (about 4 m at 113 m) further east than the rendered two-storey range, whose east end is the 1911 sheet's
differences.how: a gap a pre-1902 picture and the post-1902 map disagree about, inside the sheet fit's own 3.08 m RMS; the sheet draws a one-storey frame room in that place, built as such, and is the nearer to 1904

differences.what: the roof's rise: the print's ridge behind the trees reads up to about 1 m lower than the 45 degree gable
differences.how: the ridge is read through branches and is not legible to a metre; K04 slates nothing under 45 degrees on the 3 in headlap its slates are cut for, and the 1891 plate draws the frame house's gables steep
a monochrome print: the stone drab is reconstructed (docs/LIBERTIES.md L-k01-1721-frame-house-3566), set by the print's reading the frame walls a little darker than the pale front

differences.what: Little's brick front at the left edge (x 30-110 px) and the Pullman house
differences.how: the front stands about 10 m further west in the print than in 1904 (the move above), and is the plate's view's business; the Pullman house is its own records' (data/reference_views/pullman_house_1729_prairie/)

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
